title: Port the EPP Markdown and compliance renderer contract
goal: Preserve the current generated EPP manual-browser Markdown, compliance, CFR, regulatory rendering, reader presentation, and visible review/editing affordance contract in the standalone app.
acceptance_criteria: Treat the current generated EPP manual-browser file at /home/irovian/Dovaxis - DevOps/Emergency Prep Project/_reviews/epp-manual-browser/index.html?v=1779817496 as the visual and behavior baseline; older saved screenshots are historical context only
Reader output strips internal sections while keeping canonical Markdown unchanged
Headings, anchors, lists, code blocks, tables, assembly blocks, regulatory segments, placeholders, and inline CFR links render correctly from service-backed compatibility output

The EPP reader presentation is brought closer to the current generated browser: DOVAXIS logo-forward top bar, compact left navigation, centered paper-like reader, pale masthead, document utility icon tray, readable document typography, and quieter metadata/context placement

Visible reader affordances from the current generated browser are represented in the standalone app, including the bottom-right assistant bubble, docked review handle or lens sliver beside the reader, assistant panel shell, editable-section pencil affordance, inline edit toolbar shape, and draft-review New/Old lens overlay

Draft/review/lens states may use deterministic fixture or demo state in this slice, but their DOM, styling, and screenshot-visible behavior must be stable enough for SG-0014 to wire persistent draft review and proposal apply/reject behavior
Compliance graph links, source metadata, CFR pages, Appendix Z pages, and static regulatory lockout are represented with current generated-browser parity as the comparison point
Desktop screenshot smoke covers representative policy, Appendix A, Survey Guidance, CFR, placeholder-heavy content, assistant panel, edit-mode affordances, and draft-review lens states
The SG-0015 smoke harness remains the local validation path; any new screenshot coverage writes disposable evidence under .tmp and does not require persistent visual baselines
non_goals: Editing or rewriting regulatory source documents
Full redesign of every artifact renderer
Persistent inline edit saves, live apply, model proposal queueing, approval history, or write-back review workflow implementation, which remain SG-0014 scope
Adopting Playwright, Cypress, cloud CI, or persistent pixel-diff baselines as repo dependencies in this slice
Pixel-perfect visual matching across every EPP document
validation: Compare rendered output against the current generated EPP manual-browser file for representative documents
Capture desktop screenshots for the current generated browser baseline and the standalone Archivist counterpart at 1440x1000
Confirm screenshot coverage includes default policy, Appendix A, Survey Guidance, CFR, placeholder-heavy content, assistant panel, edit-mode affordance, and draft-review lens states

technical_defaults.summary: Use the current generated EPP manual-browser HTML as the parity baseline.
details: Older saved screenshots are useful as historical context but should not drive acceptance.

technical_defaults.summary: Preserve visible edit and review affordances without implementing the full write workflow in SG-0003.
details: Include the assistant bubble, docked review handle or lens sliver, assistant panel shell, editable-section pencil/tool affordances, and draft-review New/Old lens state in the parity target.
Use fixture or demo state where needed for screenshot validation.
Persistent manual edit draft capture, proposal apply/reject, audit, and write-back behavior remain SG-0014 scope.

technical_defaults.summary: Use Playwright only as ad hoc prep evidence unless the repo later chooses a formal browser test dependency.
details: Current prep evidence was captured with an existing local Playwright install plus Chrome.
The SG-0015 lightweight smoke harness remains the repo validation path for this slice.

prep_summary.resolved_human_choice: The current generated EPP manual-browser surface, including editing and draft-review lens affordances, is the parity baseline for SG-0003.
top_risks: The current Archivist reader is functionally service-backed but visually more app/tool-dense than the generated EPP paper-like surface.
The generated browser's edit/review affordances are sophisticated enough that SG-0003 should preserve their visible hooks while SG-0014 owns full persistence and review behavior.

Renderer parity spans Markdown, compliance, CFR, Survey Guidance, Appendix A artifacts, and UI presentation, so validation needs a small representative screenshot set rather than broad pixel-perfect coverage.

changed_surfaces: service/archivist_service.py extends the compatibility Markdown renderer for internal section stripping, hidden title anchors, CFR citation links, assembly blocks, and regulatory segment blocks

src/main.tsx and src/styles.css reshape the standalone reader toward the current generated EPP browser: DOVAXIS-forward header, compact navigation, paper-like reader, pale masthead, utility tray, context rail, assistant bubble, review handle, edit affordance, and draft-review lens demo states

scripts/smoke_archivist.py expands service and browser coverage across representative policy, Appendix A, placeholder-heavy content, Survey Guidance, CFR, assistant panel, edit mode, draft-review lens, and service-required states

validation_commands.evidence: Passed directly and again inside npm run smoke:all.

Run service-20260527T041401Z verified representative document reads plus assembly block, regulatory segment, CFR inline-link, internal-section stripping, Appendix A artifact context, and missing Markdown fallback checks.
Run browser-20260527T041245Z captured expanded desktop screenshots including assistant, edit, and draft-review affordance states.
Run all-20260527T041520Z produced summary.json, service-summary.json, browser-summary.json, and nine screenshots under .tmp/archivist-smoke/all-20260527T041520Z.

residual_risks: Assistant, inline edit, and draft-review lens states are deterministic demo affordances in this slice; persistent draft capture, model proposal queues, apply/reject, audit, and write-back remain SG-0014 scope.
The EPP visual contract is representative and screenshot-covered, not pixel-perfect across every document.
Browser smoke depends on local headless Chrome and free local ports for temporary service/Vite processes.

review_result.summary: Human review accepted the SG-0003 parity slice as passable, roughly 90% of the desired visual/layout target. Remaining cosmetic polish is intentionally deferred until the real edit/draft/review workflow creates representative UI pressure.

notes: Use the current generated browser as behavior and visual evidence. Prefer staged React/service slices over copying generated HTML. SG-0013 completed the service-backed browser shell and document-read compatibility output, so this item is now ready to build. The May 27 prep pass corrected the baseline from older saved screenshots to the current generated index.html?v=1779817496 and explicitly pulled assistant/edit/draft-review lens affordances into the parity contract while leaving persistent write/review behavior to SG-0014.
